review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer II
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will work closely with network, compute, and controls teams to bring data from the field into our platforms, and you will administer the core infrastructure tooling that keeps it all running. Responsibilities Provisioning and operating systems Administer and operate MAAS (Metal as a Service) for bare-metal provisioning, including machine enlistment, commissioning, and deployment workflows Build and maintain standardized OS images, cloud-init configurations, and deployment templates for Linux
eligibility_evidence: Location This role is a hybrid remote position based in Salt Lake City.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on role for an engineer who is comfortable crossing boundaries between servers, networks, and industrial equipment. Responsibilities Provisioning and operating systems Administer and operate MAAS (Metal as a Service) for bare-metal provisioning, including machine enlistment, commissioning, and deployment workflows Build and maintain standardized OS images, cloud-init configurations, and deployment templates for Linux hosts Automate OS patching, configuration management, and baseline compliance across the fleet Troubleshoot provisioning, boot, and OS-level issues, and document root causes and fixes Work with Compute Engineering on the handoff between hardware standards (BIOS, boot order, BMC) and the MAAS workflow Secure remote access and connectivity Deploy and maintain Tailscale subnet routers and related access infrastructure across sites, designed for high availability
